BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to emergency shelters; and adding a new section tochapter 28A.525 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.525RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each public school in Washington shall be made available to thepublic as an emergency shelter during states of emergency. Thefacilities must have a system in place to alert members of the publicthat such facilities are available to the general public during statesof emergency and, to the best of their ability, provide water, shelter,and utilities to the public.
